about_the_game:
The Last Tape

A Hidden Truth

For over 50 years, Lurmont has kept dark and disturbing events hidden from the public eye. But everything changes when, during an exploration, tapes are discovered revealing the atrocities committed by the company.

Only You

After months of investigating Lurmont’s clandestine activities, you decide to venture alone into an abandoned estate that once belonged to the company. Unaware of what awaits you, you step into a place where the truth has been buried for years.

Horror Without Horror?

The Last Tape aims to immerse you in a constant psychological horror atmosphere, creating a sense of unease and suspense at all times. However, the game does not rely on cheap jump scares or extreme tension... or does it?

The Story Doesn't End with the Prologue

The narrative of The Last Tape will continue to evolve through chapters released periodically from the same launcher. Each new episode will offer unique experiences in found footage format, although the prologue will take a different approach. All the stories are connected, but it’s up to you to discover how.

A Game Created by Two Passionate Developers

This project was developed by two students passionate about the horror genre, aiming to deliver an innovative psychological horror experience. We use the powerful Unreal Engine 5 to bring this eerie adventure to life, keeping the price accessible to everyone. Plus, the prologue will be available completely free.

Proyect Tape

The story will begin with the Prologue of the same, every X time new chapters will be released

short_description: Experience the arrival of The Last Tape's protagonist in this short horror adventure that reveals what happened before the main events. Explore Lurmont’s abandoned facilities, avoid the mysterious creature, and descend step by step into a hell you might not escape from
